summary: Adds three new endpoints: a user search by name, a per-key request counter, and an upstream status probe. It also registers them in main.go.

findings.title: Search query built from request input
findings.description: Search copies the name query parameter straight into the SQL text with Sprintf. A quote in name ends the string literal and lets the caller append their own SQL. Anyone who can call GET /users can read or change any data the database user can reach. Pass name to QueryContext as a bound parameter instead of formatting it into the query.
findings.suggested_change: rows, err := h.DB.QueryContext(r.Context(), "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name = ?", name)
findings.problem: Search copies the name query parameter straight into the SQL text with Sprintf. A quote in name ends the string literal and lets the caller append their own SQL.
findings.consequence: Anyone who can call GET /users can read or change any data the database user can reach.
findings.fix: Pass name to QueryContext as a bound parameter instead of formatting it into the query.

findings.title: Mutex left locked on missing key
findings.description: Count takes h.mu and then returns early when key is empty, so the mutex is never released. Every later Count call then blocks forever on h.mu.Lock. One request without a key makes GET /count hang for every client until the process restarts. Check key before taking the lock, or release the lock with defer right after Lock.

findings.title: Response body closed before error check
findings.description: fetchStatus defers resp.Body.Close before it checks err. When http.Get fails, resp is nil, so the deferred call panics on a nil pointer. Upstream panics instead of answering 502 whenever the upstream is unreachable. The client gets a dropped connection and the server logs a panic. Move the defer after the err check so it runs only when resp is non-nil.

findings.title: New handlers have no covering tests
findings.description: The change adds the Search, Count and Upstream handlers, but the repository has no test files. No test catches the lock leak, the nil response panic or the injection bug in these handlers. Add httptest-based tests for each handler, including the empty key path and the unreachable upstream path.
